why_standard_slice_is_insufficient.why_one_bounded_parent_pass_is_insuffici: Each sequence has an independent owner, entrypoint, retry lifecycle, and verification surface, but both must preserve one protocol.
why_standard_slice_is_insufficient.failure_mode_decomposition_prevents: A consumer can accept a stale or partially published generation after producer recovery if either slice changes the identity or publication protocol independently.
